_comment: Tier-2 for skfem nonlinear#3: basis.interpolate(u).grad has shape (spatial_dim, n_elements, n_quadrature_points). Measured on skfem 12.0.1: MeshTri().refined(2) with ElementTriP1 gives (2, 32, 3) -- 32 triangles, 3 quadrature points each -- and .grad[0] indexes the x-component across all elements and points. Confusing the axis order is the failure mode, so the fixture shows the transposed read picking up the wrong-shaped slice.
